system.description:
The namesake power of the Path of Paradox: the Ravnos reaches past illusion entirely and directly alters or unmakes real matter, be it object or living creature, for the remainder of the scene.

System: The Ravnos spends ten Blood Points and rolls Manipulation + Subterfuge (difficulty 6 for inanimate objects, or the victim's Willpower for conscious targets). Successes determine severity: 1 = render harmless or wreathe in illusory smoke, 2 = transmute into another mundane object, 3 = render insubstantial, 4 = drastic transmutation, 5 = locally suspend physical laws, 6+ = permanently delete the matter entirely. Against conscious targets, the Ravnos may instead inflict two unsoakable aggravated damage per success, or a temporary reduction of one Strength or Stamina dot per success.

MET: Methuselah Discipline. The Ravnos spends ten Blood Traits and wins a Static Mental Challenge (difficulty 6 Traits) against objects, or a Mental Challenge against conscious targets, then spends one Mental Trait per aspect changed or per level of unreducible aggravated damage inflicted (short of Methuselah-level Fortitude). Effects on inanimate objects may extend to everything of that type within the Ravnos's line of sight at no additional cost.
